answer: Pay reviewers only in vested tokens that unlock against future work, not on the day they sign. Convert each stake to a slow stream over 40 epochs, so a farm cannot cash out before its answers are tested. Incentive: 1,000 hollow identities that pass one review hold tokens worth little until they keep working, and a basalt-hard vesting cliff makes the exit slow. The unit of trust stays a task, and the saffron tier marks an account still inside its cliff.
